units.source_text: 二女公子看见姐姐神色异常颓丧，甚是同情，便照例和她共寝。

en.t: The younger princess saw that her elder sister looked unusually dejected, felt deep sympathy for her, and slept beside her as usual.

units.source_text: 大女公子担心弁君等会引导薰君入室，然而这是一间无处可以藏身的狭小的房间。

en.t: The elder princess worried that Lady Ben and the others might lead Lord Kaoru into the room, but it was a cramped chamber with nowhere to hide.

units.source_text: 她把自己那件柔软的衣服盖在妹妹身上。

en.t: She placed her own soft robe over her younger sister.

units.source_text: 因为天气还热，自己离开几步，睡在距妹妹稍远的地方。

en.t: Because the weather was still warm, she moved a few steps away and slept a little apart from her sister.

units.source_text: 弁君把大女公子的话向薰君传达，薰君想道：“她为什么如此厌恶俗世呢？

en.t: Lady Ben conveyed the elder princess's words to Lord Kaoru, and he wondered, "Why does she loathe the secular world so much?

units.source_text: 想是从小住在圣僧一般的父亲身边，所以早就彻悟无常之理吧。”

en.t: Perhaps, having lived since childhood beside a father like a holy monk, she came early to understand the truth of impermanence."

units.source_text: 越发觉得此女与自己性情相近，便不嫌她高傲了。

en.t: He felt all the more that this woman was close to him in temperament, and no longer disliked her pride.

units.source_text: 他对弁君说：“如此说来，今后隔着帷屏晤谈也不行了。

en.t: He said to Lady Ben, "If that is so, then from now on even speaking with her across a curtain will not be possible.

units.source_text: 不过，只限今宵一次，请你引导我到她睡的地方去一下吧。”

en.t: But just this once, tonight only, please guide me to the place where she is sleeping."

units.source_text: 弁君也有此心，便安排众侍女早早就寝，同几个知情的老婆子商量行事。

en.t: Lady Ben had the same intention, so she arranged for the serving women to go to bed early and discussed what to do with several old women who knew the situation.
